First, we convert the given mixed number to an improper fraction:

$$
2\,\dfrac{2}{5} = \dfrac{(2\times 5)+2}{5}=\dfrac{12}{5}
$$

To find the reciprocal of a fraction, we switch the numerator and the denominator:

$$
\dfrac{\color{blue}12}{\color{red}5} \quad\rightarrow\quad \dfrac{\color{red}5}{\color{blue}12}
$$

So the reciprocal of $2\,\dfrac{2}{5}$ is $\dfrac{5}{12}.$
